title: POST /tournaments/:id/teams/:team/withdraw request
description: A team leaves the event from round `from_round` on (at the latest the next round to pair): every player of its roster withdrawn, its later matches already paired forfeited to the opponents, a match under way keeping its games and losing its open boards. A restore point is taken first. POST .../reinstate brings it back. Answered with team-detail-response.schema.json.
